data.one_liner: Flutter PDF Viewer library to display PDF documents seamlessly and efficiently.
data.what_it_does: The Flutter PDF Viewer plugin lets you view PDF documents seamlessly and efficiently on Android, iOS, Web, Windows, and macOS platforms. It provides interactive features like magnification, virtual scrolling, page navigation, text selection, text search, form filling, and text markup annotations.
use_when: You need to display PDF documents from assets, network, files, or memory in your Flutter app.
You require advanced PDF features like text selection, search, annotations, form filling, and bookmark navigation.
avoid_when: You need a free open-source package, as this is a commercial package requiring a Syncfusion license.
You only need simple file picking without an in-app viewer.
strengths: High performance with virtual scrolling for large documents.
Rich built-in features including text markup, text search, form filling, and bookmark navigation.
Cross-platform support for Android, iOS, Web, Windows, and macOS.
weaknesses: Commercial package requiring a Syncfusion license or community license.
Requires additional script tag configurations in web index.html for PDF.js.
data.setup_notes: For web platform, you must add the PDF.js script tags to your web/index.html file.
